training_setup.optimizer: SGD, momentum 0.9, nesterov, weight decay 5e-4, lr 0.1

task3.method: Average-rank fusion of 5 ResNet-18 runs trained from scratch (60 epochs each): plain CE (seed 0), SOP, plain CE (seed 1), ELR, and CE retrained with per-image weights taken from the fused scores of the first four. Each run is scored by the log-ratio margin of its epoch-averaged softmax probabilities; higher means more likely mislabeled. Result (clean labels used only for measuring): precision@k 0.880 (k=18109), AUROC 0.965.
